Copper alloy statuette of a male standing worshipper, with his right arm raised. An inscription on the back indicates it as a votive gift from Etel-pi-Shamash, an official at Isin, and possibly a son of Iddin-Dagan, king of Isin (1974-1954 BC). ME 91145.
